---

Title format:
`<type>(<scope>): <outcome> (TICKET-N)`

Examples:
- `docs(pr): add repo PRDS template (TICKET-PRDS-1)`
- `feat(runbooks): add Windows AI safety guidance (TICKET-WS-42)`

Conventional Commit subject required for every PR title.
